channel.title: Football's Greatest Bears News
channel.description: Original FGB-written Chicago Bears news briefs with source attribution for Football's Greatest Bears live programming.

item.title: Bears open the 2026 preseason Saturday against Cleveland at Soldier Field with kickoff set for noon Central
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago's lone home preseason game is Saturday against the Browns before the Bears finish the exhibition schedule with two road games.

item.title: NFL schedule sends the Bears to joint practices in Cincinnati and Tennessee before their final two preseason games
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago is scheduled to practice with the Bengals on August 20 and the Titans on August 27 before playing each club on the road.

item.title: Yahoo's camp calendar shows two more public Bears practices at Halas Hall after Saturday's Cleveland preseason opener
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago's remaining listed public training camp practices are August 18 and August 25, with road joint practices and preseason games in between.

item.title: CBS lists Cleveland first before Chicago finishes the preseason with road games against Cincinnati and Tennessee
item.description: FGB brief: CBS Sports lists the Browns at Soldier Field on August 15, followed by Bears road dates at Cincinnati on August 22 and Tennessee on August 29.

item.title: Sports Illustrated says Bears camp questions center on Caleb Williams' accuracy, pass rush and replacing veteran leadership
item.description: FGB analysis: Chicago enters the preseason evaluating whether offensive continuity, defensive pressure and younger players can answer several of the roster's biggest questions.
